name: your-golf-buddy
description: Your Golf Buddy monorepo — offline-first golf score tracking (web PWA), a cloud sync service, a course-location service, and a mobile client.

scripts.cf:d1:create: ./scripts/with-env.sh pnpm --filter profile-sync exec wrangler d1 create ygb-profile-sync
scripts.cf:kv:create: ./scripts/with-env.sh pnpm --filter course-ls exec wrangler kv namespace create COURSE_CACHE
scripts.cf:secret:google: ./scripts/with-env.sh pnpm --filter course-ls exec wrangler secret put GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
